Multiple Rule Changes Take Effect Across India From July 1

Several new rules and changes have come into effect across India starting July 1. These include revised passport application fees, updates to Aadhaar services, changes in LPG prices, and the resumption of EPFO online services. The changes impact various financial and regulatory aspects for citizens and businesses.
